cycle: Standard Inspection Time per Piece — filled in from the Part when picked, and can be changed for the day.
shift: Inspection Working Hours = Inspection End Time − Inspection Start Time
idealQty: Ideal Inspection Quantity = Inspection Working Hours × 3600 ÷ Standard Inspection Time per Piece — not rounded down, as on the sheet.
rejectedQty: Rejected Quantity = Actual Quantity − OK Quantity, so OK + Rejected = Actual. The breakdown shows how that total splits across the reasons entered on the form.
pctOk: % OK Quantity = OK Quantity ÷ (OK Quantity + Rejected Quantity)
unutilized: Unutilized Machine Time = (12 − (Shift Hours − Lunch ÷ 60)) ÷ 11, with Shift Hours and Lunch added up across every entry of this machine's date — so every entry of that machine/date shows the same figure. Shown as 0% when the result is below 0 and 100% when it is above 100.
totalStoppage: Total Idle Time (Min) = Lunch / Tea / Washroom + Other
effective: Ideal Inspection Time (hours) = TOTAL QTY × Standard Inspection Time per Piece ÷ 3600 — every piece inspected counts.
unreported: Unreported Time (min) = Planned Operator Shift × 60 − Ideal Inspection Time × 60 − Time in Other Activity − Total Idle Time, for this entry (with Process Master's fixed shift: combined across the worker's whole date).
setupEff: Setup Efficiency = Effective Machine Run Time ÷ Machine Shift Time
oeeLosses: OEE considering losses = Effective Run Time ÷ (Available Hours − Total Downtime ÷ 60), combined across every entry of this machine's date.
oeeLunch: OEE not considering losses but lunch = Effective Run Time ÷ (Available Hours − Lunch ÷ 60), combined across every entry of this machine's date.
oeeLunchCot: OEE not considering losses but lunch and setup time = Effective Run Time ÷ (Available Hours − Lunch ÷ 60 − Setup Time ÷ 60), combined across every entry of this machine's date.
availability: Availability = Operating Time ÷ Planned Production Time, for this entry. Operating Time = Inspection Working Hours − Total Idle Time − Other Activity; Planned Production Time = Planned Operator Shift − Lunch / Tea. Above 100% (red) sends the entry to Admin review.
performance: Performance = Standard Inspection Time per Piece × TOTAL QTY ÷ Operating Time, for this entry — how fast the inspection went against the standard time. Above 100% (red) sends the entry to Admin review: usually a wrong time per piece, quantity or idle time.
quality: Quality = OK QTY ÷ TOTAL QTY, for this entry.
review: Admin review: an entry whose Availability, Performance, Quality or any of its OEE figures (the Productivity figures, on a worker sheet) is above 100% is held as Pending review until an Admin or Super Admin approves or rejects it. Editing the figures sends it back for review; hover for details.
idealQtyPerHour: Ideal Inspection Quantity/Hour = 3600 ÷ Standard Inspection Time per Piece
totalDefect: Total Defects = Blow Holes Casting + Crack/Damage Casting + Other
okQty: OK QTY = TOTAL QTY − Total Defects
productivity: Productivity without considering Lunch, tea, etc. = Ideal Inspection Time ÷ (Planned Operator Shift − Other Activity ÷ 60), for this entry (with Process Master's fixed shift: combined across the worker's whole date).
productivityLunch: Productivity considering Lunch, tea, etc. = Ideal Inspection Time ÷ (Planned Operator Shift − Other Activity ÷ 60 − Lunch / Tea ÷ 60), for this entry (with Process Master's fixed shift: combined across the worker's whole date).
